content:
Best Buy has updated its major 60th anniversary sale event, adding a new round of discounts. We will continue tracking multiple deals, including AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, and AirTag 2 hitting a historic low. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break features a 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at a massive $500 discount on Amazon, Anker's newly released SmartTrack Find My wallet card down to a new low of $25, and Mint Mobile's unlimited talk, text, and data annual plan at half price, just $15 per month. All deals are listed below.

Best Buy's major 60th anniversary sale adds a new round of deals: TVs starting from $110, tech products up to 50% off, home appliances $1,000 off, and more

AirPods discounts deepen further, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, plus more deals

Following the continued discounts on Apple's latest AirPods lineup throughout the summer, prices on nearly every model have dropped again. The popular AirPods Pro 3 is now selling at a 25% discount, one of the best prices ever; the AirPods 4 with ANC has also dropped to its lowest price in months, while the AirPods Max 2 dropped another $120 this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Rare M4 Mac mini deal surfaces today at Apple's official refurbished store, $150 off

Update: This deal has sold out, we'll be watching closely for restocks.

While AirPods Pro 3, the new AirTag 2, and M5 MacBook Pro all have solid deals, the latest M4 Mac mini has been extremely hard to find. Retailers like Amazon and Best Buy have been nearly sold out, and previous deals have been rare. We just spotted an extremely rare opportunity to grab a 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini at $150 off through Apple's official refurbished store.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage at $849, with free shipping.

New low: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at massive $500 discount on Amazon

Several configurations of this week's new M5 Pro MacBook Pro have significant $400 discounts as part of a special Apple one-day event. However, we want to highlight one particular model — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off on Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in SSD at $2,699, with free shipping.

This is the $3,199 configuration with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (rather than the current $400-off version with 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU). Although this model's price was recently raised, it's still $100 less than its previous lower MSRP.

Both options are solid choices depending on the performance you need — now $400 and $500 off respectively; the CPU/GPU upgrade typically costs an extra $200, but with the current deal, you only pay $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 discount will quickly return to full price, but cannot confirm whether it will last through the end of this weekend's major sale event.

Apple's latest AirTag 2 hits a historic low on Amazon this week, but here's how to get one for $20

Apple deals are in full swing this week, with AirPods Pro 3 maintaining a 25% discount and the latest AirPods Max 2 also at its best-ever $120 discount. Beyond multiple M5 Pro MacBook Pro models at $500 off, other notable deals include the latest AirTag 2 trackers, with single and 4-packs returning to historic lows — but you can now get one for as little as $20.

Amazon has dropped the prices of both the AirTag 2 single pack and 4-pack back to the lowest since their earlier launch this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

At the 4-pack price, each tracker averages just $22.25, while the single-pack AirTag 2 returns to its Prime Day historic low of $24.

Although the difference isn't huge, it's worth noting that Best Buy's "Excellent" rated open-box single-pack AirTag 2 is also the lowest we've seen — available for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 "Excellent" Open-Box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy

While this price is only $4 less than Amazon's new unit, I'm personally inclined to buy new, but it is indeed cheaper. Best Buy also has the same deal on new units, so if you're already ordering through their ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it's worth checking their options.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week deal: $100 off, Best Buy open-box starting from $254

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My wallet card (supports iOS or Android) drops to historic low of $25 on Amazon

Anker recently launched its new SmartTrack Find My Card — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — and it's now dropped to a new historic low of $25 on Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's EufyHome Amazon official store is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (supports iOS or Android) at $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This product launched on Amazon last month at $35, got a slight $5 discount by month's end, and now sees its first major discount, hitting a new Amazon historic low.

That's nearly a 30% discount, on par with some of the better wallet tracker card deals this year.

I'm personally a big fan of Nomad's tracking cards — starting from $35, with the Pro model featuring 16 months of rechargeable battery life priced at $45 — but regardless of which one, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or card holder. I never leave home without one.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, compatibility with Apple Find My or Google Find Hub. At only 1.7mm thick with a ringer volume of up to 80dB, it's easy to hear nearby — and of course, it integrates directly with the Find My and Find Hub apps for location viewing on a map.

Mint Mobile launches half-price deal: unlimited talk, text, and data annual plan just $15 per month

Mint Mobile is currently running a great deal on unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. While this carrier offers good value most of the year, its unlimited 12-month plan is now just $15 per month — that's half price, meaning a full year of unlimited talk, text, and data for just $180. Even if you don't plan to switch your main plan right now, this price is low enough to consider for an iPad backup or secondary line.

While the 17GB and 23GB plans also have discounts, the best value here is the 5G • 4G LTE plan: unlimited / 12 months, just $15 per month.

  • Mint Mobile 12-month unlimited plan $15/month (half price)

According to the fine print, you need to prepay $180 for the 12-month plan (that's $15 per month), but for those looking to switch carriers at a discount, or wanting to add a secondary line / backup for other devices, this deal is very attractive.

If your phone supports eSIM, you can "activate service instantly," available on many Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. If needed, you can keep your existing number and bring your own unlocked phone to use this service.

Please visit the deal page for more details.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits historic low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also discounted)

As part of the late summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home lineup, Amazon is also selling the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro at its lowest price ever, while the wired version is also reduced back to its Prime Day historic low — both nearly 30% below MSRP.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker's MagSafe chargers start from $36 this week, with free shipping (multiple color options)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is the top pick, now 35% off (historic low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I've seen, $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South all-in-one fabric PowerCord USB-C charger drops to $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable, now down to $36
  • Woot's major PC sale officially kicks off, gaming desktops, monitors, coolers and more up to 75% off, deals from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with display features power loss protection, today only $29
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub hits historic low of $52 (57% off)
  • Twelve South USB-C wall charger with Find My just hit historic low on Amazon, under $37
  • Wow! These genuine leather Apple Watch bands are just $6, free shipping with Prime (75% off)

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 in stock, all $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's major 60th anniversary sale brings one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon offering $120 off MSRP across all five colors.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 at $429, with free shipping.

Compared to the previous generation's $549 MSRP, you're now $120 off, which is the best price we've seen for a new unit at a reputable retailer.

Best Buy's "Excellent" rated open-box Midnight Black is down to $403.99, with free shipping — although it's cheaper, it may not be low enough to forgo the appeal of a new unit.

Apple really launched a completely new generation of AirPods Max this year, not just new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear option won't be updated at next month's new product event, so this week's $120 discount may stick around for a while — this is Apple's latest and greatest over-ear headphones.

The only previous lower price was this summer's Prime Day, which was $30 less than today's deal — and that 4-day promotion had very limited and unstable inventory.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models drop $220 today (matching Prime Day prices)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my go-to for iPhone deals, Apple still hasn't listed the latest iPhone 17 Pro series — likely waiting for next month's iPhone 18 series launch. Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed products have returned to Prime Day pricing, with savings of up to $220 off new MSRP.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed models have consistently been the best deal on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro so far. You not only save hundreds, but also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "over 90% original battery life" — Amazon's non-"premium" refurbished products only have a 90-day warranty and different battery life performance.

Now the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock with up to $220 off — the 512GB version is $20 less than the last price we mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

As reported in yesterday's Apple refurbished store feature, you can get a powerful iPhone 16 model starting from $699 with 1-year Apple warranty, or a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 starting from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger still at $26 low, but this bundle is just $4 more and includes a USB-C cable

Take-Two officially files subpoena with federal court to track down GTA VI leaker
